heading: Review of threats to historic property
lead: At least once every 4 years, the Secretary, in consultation with the Council and with State Historic Preservation Officers, shall review significant threats to historic property to—

tree.text: determine the kinds of historic property that may be threatened;
ascertain the causes of the threats; and
develop and submit to the President and Congress recommendations for appropriate action.
